description: Every Sherweb Partner API capability, plus a local SQLite store, offline analytics, and margin/drift/orphan joins no other Sherweb tool has.

tools.name: distributor_get-payable-charges
tools.description: Returns the charges you are billed by Sherweb for a billing period: products, quantities, list/net pricing, fees, taxes, and deductions. Optional: date.

params.name: date
params.description: A date within the desired billing period (yyyy-MM-dd, UTC). Default: today.

tools.name: service-provider_amend-subscriptions
tools.description: Submit one or more subscription quantity changes. Returns a tracking id. Required: customerId, subscriptionAmendmentParameters.

tools.name: service-provider_cancel-subscriptions
tools.description: Cancel one or more of a customer's subscriptions. Required: customerId, subscriptionIds. Returns the new TrackingRef.

tools.name: service-provider_get-customer-catalog
tools.description: Get the product catalog available to a specific customer. Required: customerId. Returns the CustomerCatalog.

tools.name: service-provider_get-customer-catalog-items-pricing
tools.description: Get pricing for specific catalog items for a customer. Required: customerId, skus. Returns the new ServiceProviderGetCustomerCatalogItemsPricingResponse.

tools.name: service-provider_get-customer-platform-details
tools.description: Get details for one provisioned platform of a customer. Required: customerId, platformId. Returns the ServiceProviderGetCustomerPlatformDetailsResponse.

tools.name: service-provider_get-customer-platform-meter-usages
tools.description: Get metered usage for a customer's platform. Required: customerId, platformId. Returns the ServiceProviderGetCustomerPlatformMeterUsagesResponse.

tools.name: service-provider_get-customer-platforms-configurations
tools.description: Get the platform configurations provisioned for a customer. Required: customerId. Returns the ServiceProviderGetCustomerPlatformsConfigurationsResponse.

tools.name: service-provider_get-platform-required-parameters
tools.description: Get the required provisioning parameters for given SKUs/platform. Required: skus. Returns the new ServiceProviderGetPlatformRequiredParametersResponse.

tools.name: service-provider_get-platforms-for-skus
tools.description: Resolve which platforms can fulfill given SKUs. Required: skus. Returns the new ServiceProviderGetPlatformsForSkusResponse.

tools.name: service-provider_get-receivable-charges
tools.description: Get receivable charges (what a customer owes you) for a date. Required: customerId. Optional: date. Returns the ServiceProviderGetReceivableChargesResponse.

params.name: date
params.description: Date within the billing period (yyyy-MM-dd, UTC). Default: today.

tools.name: service-provider_get-subscription-meters
tools.description: Get metered subscriptions for a customer. Required: customerId. Returns the ServiceProviderGetSubscriptionMetersResponse.

tools.name: service-provider_get-subscriptions-pricing
tools.description: Get pricing information for a customer's subscriptions. Required: customerId. Returns the ServiceProviderGetSubscriptionsPricingResponse.

tools.name: service-provider_get-tracking-status
tools.description: Get the status of an order or amendment by tracking id. Required: trackingId. Returns the ServiceProviderGetTrackingStatusResponse.

params.name: trackingId
params.description: Tracking id returned by an order/amendment/cancellation.

tools.name: service-provider_list-customers
tools.description: List the customers under your reseller account. Optional: page, pageSize. Returns array of Customer.

tools.name: service-provider_list-platforms
tools.description: List the provisioning platforms available to you. Returns the ServiceProviderListPlatformsResponse.

tools.name: service-provider_list-subscriptions
tools.description: List a customer's subscriptions with details. Required: customerId. Returns array of Subscription.

tools.name: service-provider_place-order
tools.description: Place a marketplace order for a customer. Required: customerId, cartItems. Returns the new TrackingRef.

tools.name: service-provider_validate-order
tools.description: Validate an order cart for a customer before placing it. Required: customerId, cartItems. Returns the new ServiceProviderValidateOrderResponse.
